title: Already blocked or disabled card - support procedure
keywords: my debit card is blocked only
aliases: my debit card is blocked only
content: For a blocked card, check whether the restriction affects ATM withdrawals, online payments or all uses. For account-specific card status, your identity must be verified first. Use the secure banking channel to request a review or replacement; never share your PIN or one-time codes.
